pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, 10.d4 Nbd7 11.Nbd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3/e3 as if the knight were already on f1; plan 2 sent the d7-knight to f8, where the rook stands; plan 3 used a g3-knight that is not there and an Re1-e3-g3 lift onto the knight's square; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote all four plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, 10.d4 Nbd7 11.Nbd2 Bb7 12.Bc2
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a bare Nf1-g3 (or e3); plan 4 put the d7-knight on f8 before the rook and bishop make room. Rewrote plans 1 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, Main Line, 13.Nf1
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave f2-f4 as White's main long-term plan, which is not a Breyer idea; plan 2 had ...Bf8 'overprotecting e7'. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, Main Line, 13.Nf1 Bf8 14.Ng3
pages.notes: Plan 1 called d5 a break that opens the centre and gave a Qg4 the f3-knight blocks; plan 2 had ...Na5-c4 with no knight able to reach a5. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, Main Line, 14.Ng3 g6
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the g3-knight to f5 and h5, both covered by ...g6. Rewrote it around a4, d5, Bg5 and Be3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, Main Line, 15.a4 c5
pages.notes: Plan 1 said d5 opens the centre and sent the knight to f5/h5, covered by ...g6; plan 2 had ...exd5, a capture the e5-pawn cannot make. Rewrote both around 16.d5 c4 and ...Nc5. British spelling.

pages.name: Romanishin Variation, Ruy Lopez
pages.notes: Plan 2 followed ...h6 with ...g5 while the bishop stands on g5. Rewrote it around ...h6 and ...c5. British spelling (including less-travelled).

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Borisenko Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 manoeuvred an f1-knight that is still on b1; plan 2 rerouted via a bare Nb8-d7. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Chigorin Defense
pages.notes: Overview called c2 a passive square for the bishop; plan 3 had White control d5 with the pawn on d2; plan 4 offered a ...d5 break that is not Black's plan here. Rewrote the overview and plans 3-4 (first plan 4 rewrite rejected for saying ...Qc7 connects the rooks with the c8-bishop between them; corrected and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Chigorin Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Nd2-f1-g3 with the knight on b1 and the d-pawn on d2; plan 4 sent the a5-knight to c6/b7 squares the parser could not read and offered a ...d5 break. Rewrote both. British spelling.
